description: Top of the cross-benchmark aggregate ranking: every model placed on one rating scale by an IRT model fit over public benchmark leaderboards (call about_the_aggregate for the current coverage counts). One row per model by default, fused across reasoning-effort settings. Supports paging via limit/offset.

include_variants.description: Rank each reasoning-effort variant separately (e.g. "Claude Opus 4.6 (High)") instead of one fused row per model. Default false.

offset.description: Rows to skip from the top (default 0).

name: get_leaderboard
title: Aggregate leaderboard
